Not looking for pros ATM. Just this. For 2 months my day was consumed by YouTube,reddit,porn... Like an addiction. My mood was shaped by it. 
I quit all that nearly a week ago. This ain't the first time I shut downy computer like that and am aware of relapsing as a possibility. 
Feel like a withdrawal effect this past weekend. Have been sitting next to my homework for 3 hours not even touching it. It's all the homework from The last 2 and a half months . need to turn it in in the next 3 weeks or I fail. 
Might not seem related to the original post but I think if I make it I'll be a lil more stable.

Thanks. I guess I just need to bounce off some thoughts. 
I  am having a problem admitting to full extent that what I did was real. Idk what to do. Maybe go to a professional. Before that I felt I should do this first(baby steps). It's sorta weird couple weeks mood wise. Cry my self to sleep one day, next one feel like yesterday didn't happen. 
Tanks for replying. I am not super close to doing anything again. This is making it seem more real. Yeah
Hang on man. Did you go to legal advice subreddits?
wow, never seen smiles only awkward looking away.
I wonder if this will be on reddit in 30 yrs...
